results.rule: land manager current page is the authority for trail distances; one source -> use it
results.fact: Tin Can Gap pin has no distance; the forest trail page states 6.2 mi from the trailhead to Tin Can Gap
results.evidence: Current Forest Service page for Trail 641 gives Saddle Lake 2.5 mi and Tin Pan/Tin Can Gap 6.2 mi. The row already states Saddle Lake at about 2.5 mi and Goat Flats at about 4.5 mi plus about 2 more miles to the gap, so 6.2 adds no contradiction; the trailhead pin is distMi 0.
